g.text: 1:1 Q, K, V heads + causal mask

svg.text: Token IDs + Learned Position Embeddings (0..N−1) added once at the input

g.text: MLP(x) = GELU( x · W_fc + b₁ ) · W_proj + b₂
Expands each token's features 4× wider (e.g. d = 768 → 3072 in GPT-2; 12,288 → 49,152 in GPT-3)
to apply non-linear channel transformations independently at every sequence position.
Token Mixing — Every Query Head Has Dedicated K & V Heads
Why Multi-Head Attention (MHA) — and Its KV-Cache Footprint:
Splitting d into H parallel heads lets the model attend to H subspaces at once,
but every head caches its own separate Key & Value tensors (H_q = H_k = H_v) during decoding.
